308: The first recruited member of BECK, Taira is the bassist, and the most talented band member next to Ryusuke. He plays Music Man StingRay bass. His attitude may sometimes come off as uncaring. He has been seen working as a traffic officer.
676: The main character, the series follows his rapid development from living an average life to becoming an outstanding guitarist.
2755: Ryusuke's sister who is a talented singer with a strange relationship with Koyuki. At times she seems attracted to him, at others she brushes him off with little regard to his often ignored feelings.
4170: A Japanese character with a long history in America, he speaks fluent English, and frequently uses both Japanese and English in his conversations. He lives alone in a shack by the fishing pond. His skills and taste in music inspire Koyuki to take up the guitar.
4613: The fourth member to join, he was also Koyuki's first good friend, sticking with him even when the school bully and his gang beat him up for breaking the silent treatment on Koyuki.
4946: Main vocalist for BECK, he is the key member that Ryusuke needed to bring Taira into the band.
7395: Koyuki's guitar and swimming teacher, Saitou once swam in the Olympics but was unable to achieve his dream of winning so has turned his life to teaching others how to swim better. Saitou is loud and demanding in public, and especially strict when it comes to swimming.
7396: Koyuki's childhood friend, he eventually was left to choose between her and Maho, though by the time he reached his decision, the two girls also reached one of their own, luckily a similar conclusion.
7397: Koyuki's music teacher at school, she gets to know Saitou through Koyuki and they start to develop a relationship through the series.
7398: Originally in Ryusuke's first band, Serial Mama, he turned into his rival, and his new band, Belle Ame, formed as BECK's competition was mainly succeeding through appeal for the band member's looks and not sound.
7399: Lead guitarist of Dying Breed, he was Ryusuke's close (and only) friend. It is while they are growing up (and carjacking) that Eddie helped him find Beck (the seemingly patchwork dog) and Lucille.
12476: Masaru Hyodo is the chief instigator in a group who bully Koyuki during his middle school days. Hyodo is also a "technically" accomplished guitarist, but as Ryûsuke points out, doesn't have any real feeling or passion behind his playing.
12556: Rikiya Kitawaza is a thug attending Koyuki's middle school and a childhood friend of Hyodo.
12557: Tanabe is a school friend of Koyuki. His hobbies include photography.
13259: Yoshito Morozumi is a school friend of Maho and a budding actor and model. He competes with Koyuki for Maho's affections, often subjecting him to ridicule. He later joins Belle Ame on stage at Greatful Sound.
18316: Manabu Miyazawa is the vocalist for Eiji's group Belle Ame. Before joining Belle Ame, he was in a band called Cloud.
20298: Lead singer for Beck's American band "Dying Breed". Known as rock's craziest guy. After letting Koyuki sing with them at the stage he became a fan of him and tries to push Koyuki to the top.
20347: Hiromi Masuoka is a student at the Ichieda Gakuen Private High School attended by Koyuki, Saku, and Chiba. She also worked for a period in a doughnut shop next to Koyuki's, the Seiryuu restaurant. She is a friend of Koyuki and Saku.
141894: Beck is Ryusuke's dog. Ryusuke's band was named 'BECK' by Chiba, in reference to Beck the dog.
